classes.description:
Sets the color and angle of the light from the sun and sky.

Typical setup:
1. Create an env_sky entity to use as your skybox
2. Create a light_environment entity and set Sky IBL Source to the name of the env_sky entity
3. Right-click on your light_environment entity and select 'Selected environment light -> Estimate lighting from HDR skybox'
4. Adjust angle and brightness of the sunlight as you see fit

classes.description:
Compares an input to up to 32 preset values. If the input value is the same as any of the preset values, an output corresponding to that value is fired.

For example: if Case01 is set to 2 and Case02 is set to 5, and the input value is 5, the OnCase02 output will be fired.

This entity can also be used to select from a number of random targets via the PickRandom input. One of the OnCase outputs that is connected to another entity will be picked at random and fired.

classes.description: A physically simulated spring. 'Length' is what's known as the 'natural spring length'. This is how long the spring would be if it was at rest (nothing hanging on it or attached). When you attach something to the spring, it will stretch longer than its 'natural length'. The amount of stretch is determined by the 'Sprint Frequency'. The larger the spring frequency the less stretch the spring.

classes.description:
Turns an entity, or set of entities, into a single template that can be instanced anywhere, and multiple times. If there are interdependencies (entity I/O, hierarchy, or other name references) between the entities in the template, the entities in the template will have their names changed and the interdependencies will be reconnected to the changes names. The name change format is as follows: '&0000', where the 0000 will be replaced with the current global template instance, so wildcard searches for '*' will still find them.

If you don't want the name fixup to happen because you're only spawning the template once, or you want inputs to trigger all instances of the template, check the 'Preserve entity names' spawnflag.

To spawn the template in other places, use an env_entity_maker.

Asynch point templates have the benefit that they don't precache resources that we never spawn.

keyvalues.description: The amount of seconds after which, if any client hasn't finished streaming the necessary assets, that client is disconnected and the template spawns anyways. Only used in asynchronous point_templates. 0 means use some reasonable default set in the code.

choices.label: Spawn into the currently active spawn group
Spawn into a newly created spawn group
Only create for clients connected at the time at which point_template spawns its contents
Create for clients who connect after the point_template spawns its contents

keyvalues.description: This controls the behavior of client only entities spawned by the point_template. Either you can create them only for clients that are currently connected at the point the point_template is spawned (good for transient things like explosions), or you can create them for clients who connect after the point_template is spawned. This behavior only affects point_templates that create their own spawn groups.

classes.description: A prop that can be placed in hierarchy and can play animations and/or simulate cloth. It can also be configured to break when it takes enough damage. Note that the health of the object will be overridden by the health inside the model, to ensure consistent health game-wide. If the model used by the prop is configured to be used as a prop_physics (i.e. it should be physically simulated) then it CANNOT be used as a prop_dynamic. Upon level load it will display a warning in the console and remove itself. Use a prop_physics instead.

classes.description: A prop that physically simulates as a single rigid body. It can be constrained to other physics objects using hinges or other constraints. It can also be configured to break when it takes enough damage. Note that the health of the object will be overridden by the health inside the model, to ensure consistent health game-wide. If the model used by the prop is configured to be used as a prop_dynamic (i.e. it should not be physically simulated) then it CANNOT be used as a prop_physics. Upon level load it will display a warning in the console and remove itself. Use a prop_dynamic instead.

keyvalues.description:
Overrides how this object contributes geometry to the Steam Audio scene. The modes are mutually exclusive.
Default: No change.
Exclude: Exclude object form static geometry.
Force Static: Consider dynamic object as static geometry.
Force Dynamic: Consider object as dynamic geometry, all other dynamic objects are otherwise ignored.

keyvalues.description: Selects the type of shadows that should be cast from this prop_static.

keyvalues.description: Bakes the mesh as if it were double-sided geometry in the lightmapper. Useful on geometry with 'Render Backfaces' enabled via it's material (such as foliage). When the lightmapper sees many and/or large backfaces it will invalidate lightmap samples as an optimization, which can lead to lightmap errors/reduced quality in some circumstances.

keyvalues.description: Auto for standard LOD behaviour, or select an explicit LOD to use. Note that LODs take up more room in the lightmap and do not merge, potentially making them less performant if used on many objects (Set to Auto).

keyvalues.description: If true mesh will be baked/merged into the world geometry of the map so that the model is not referenced at runtime. Use this if you want light probed static meshes to merge

keyvalues.description: If true this will not be merged with other geometry during map compile (reduces rendering efficiency).

keyvalues.description: If true, this geometry renders into baked cube maps

keyvalues.description: When off, a direction is simply open or blocked, and each ray stops at the first thing it hits. When on, a ray counts every wall between here and the Trace Radius.

keyvalues.description: Exponent applied to cluster size

keyvalues.description: Blend between simple openness (0) and clustered openness (1).

classes.description:
An entity that triggers a level change.

Place an info_landmark in both maps in the PVS of the transition region that marks the 'same' location in each map.

TIPS & TRICKS:
To fire events in the next level, use the OnLevelChange output to turn on an env_global in the current level. Create a logic_auto in the next level that checks for the state set by the env_global.

To control which entities go through the level transition, create one or more trigger_transitions and give them the same name as the landmark. Any entities within the trigger_transition(s) will go to the next map.

classes.description: An entity used to trigger something when the player looks at something. It fires 'OnTrigger' when the player looks at a target entity for the given amount of time, while within the trigger volume. If the player leaves the trigger or looks away from the target entity the clock resets. If the 'Use Velocity instead of facing' spawnflag is checked, the trigger uses the player's velocity instead of the player's view, so it determines whenever the player is moving toward the target entity. Useful for triggering when players are driving a vehicle at something.NOTE: Only designed for single-player game.

classes.description: This is the world entity. Each map can only contain one, and it's automatically created for you.

keyvalues.description: The name that other entities refer to this entity by.
keyvalues.name: targetname

keyvalues.display_name: Level Fade In Color (R G B)
keyvalues.name: startcolor

keyvalues.description: Smallest render cluster, in units, used for geometry the compiler could not give precomputed visibility to. That geometry is always drawn, so clustering it more finely lets info_visibility_box reject it in smaller pieces, at the cost of more draw calls. 0 clusters it the same as ordinary geometry.
keyvalues.name: novis_min_draw_volume_size

keyvalues.description: Triangle budget per render cluster for geometry with no precomputed visibility. Lower values subdivide that geometry further. 0 clusters it the same as ordinary geometry.
keyvalues.name: novis_max_triangles_per_cluster

keyvalues.description: Used to clear out savegame data of previous levels to keep the savegame size as small as possible. Only set it to Yes if the player cannot return to any previous levels.
keyvalues.name: newunit

keyvalues.description: Number of pixels wide at which all props in the level start to fade (<0 = use fademaxdist). This number is ignored if the prop has a specific fade distance specified.
keyvalues.name: maxpropscreenwidth

keyvalues.description: Minimum number of pixels wide at which the prop is visible (0 = don't fade out). This number is ignored if the prop has a specific fade distance specified.
keyvalues.name: minpropscreenwidth

keyvalues.description: Generates data which can be used to lookup lightmap UVs at a given position, useful for high-fidelity illumination of bullet decals on lightmapped geometry.
keyvalues.name: lightmap_queries

keyvalues.description:
Cleanup: Reverb bake is disabled. Baked data will be cleaned up during map compile in Hammer or mapbuilder.
Manual: Reverb needs to be baked manually. Baked data is added or updated during map compile in Hammer but untouched by mapbuilder.
Auto: Reverb is baked automatically during map compile. Baked data is added or updated during map compile in Hammer or mapbuilder.
keyvalues.name: steamaudio_reverb_rebake_option

keyvalues.description:
Automatic, Everywhere: When baking, probes will be generated to cover the entire map.
Automatic, Use Probe Generation Volumes: When baking, probes will only be generated within Probe Generation Volumes that have been explicitly placed in the map.
Manual: When baking, probes will not be generated. Only probes that have been manually placed in the map will be used.
keyvalues.name: steamaudio_reverb_generation_type

keyvalues.description:
Don't generate probes inside Probe Exclusion Volumes that have been placed in the map.
(Only used if Generation Type is set to Automatic, Everywhere.)
keyvalues.name: steamaudio_reverb_filter_volumes

keyvalues.description:
Only generate probes that are near the nav mesh.
(Only used if Generation Type is set to Automatic, Everywhere.)
keyvalues.name: steamaudio_reverb_filter_navmesh

keyvalues.description: The horizontal distance (in meters) between adjacent probes.
keyvalues.name: steamaudio_reverb_grid_spacing

keyvalues.description: The height (in meters) above the floor at which probes should be placed..
keyvalues.name: steamaudio_reverb_height_above_floor

keyvalues.description: The number of rays traced from the listener when baking reflections or reverb. Increasing this value results in more accurate reflections, at the cost of increased bake times.
keyvalues.name: steamaudio_reverb_rays

keyvalues.description: The number of times each ray traced from the listener is reflected when baking reflections or reverb. Increasing this value results in longer, more accurate reverb tails, at the cost of increased bake times.
keyvalues.name: steamaudio_reverb_bounces

keyvalues.description: The duration (in seconds) of the IRs generated when baking reflections or reverb. Increasing this value results in longer, more accurate reverb tails, at the cost of increased disk space usage.
keyvalues.name: steamaudio_reverb_ir_duration

keyvalues.description: The Ambisonic order of the IRs generated when baking reflections or reverb. Increasing this value results in more accurate directional variation of reflected sound, at the cost of increased disk space usage.
keyvalues.name: steamaudio_reverb_ambisonic_order

keyvalues.description: Reduces the number of probes generated by combining nearby probes that are likely to have similar reverbs.
keyvalues.name: steamaudio_reverb_clustering_enable

keyvalues.description: Number of rays traced per side for each face of the depth cube map computed for each probe.
keyvalues.name: steamaudio_reverb_clustering_cubemap_resolution

keyvalues.description: If average depth map values at two probes are within this distance (in meters), then the probes are considered similar.
keyvalues.name: steamaudio_reverb_clustering_depth_threshold

keyvalues.description:
Cleanup: Pathing bake is disabled. Baked data will be cleaned up during map compile in Hammer or mapbuilder.
Manual: Pathing needs to be baked manually. Baked data is added or updated during map compile in Hammer but untouched by mapbuilder.
Auto: Pathing is baked automatically during map compile. Baked data is added or updated during map compile in Hammer or mapbuilder.
keyvalues.name: steamaudio_pathing_rebake_option

keyvalues.description:
Automatic, Everywhere: When baking, probes will be generated to cover the entire map.
Automatic, Use Probe Generation Volumes: When baking, probes will only be generated within Probe Generation Volumes that have been explicitly placed in the map.
Manual: When baking, probes will not be generated. Only probes that have been manually placed in the map will be used.
keyvalues.name: steamaudio_pathing_generation_type

keyvalues.description:
Don't generate probes inside Probe Exclusion Volumes that have been placed in the map.
(Only used if Generation Type is set to Automatic, Everywhere.)
keyvalues.name: steamaudio_pathing_filter_volumes

keyvalues.description:
Only generate probes that are near the nav mesh.
(Only used if Generation Type is set to Automatic, Everywhere.)
keyvalues.name: steamaudio_pathing_filter_navmesh

keyvalues.description: The horizontal distance (in meters) between adjacent probes.
keyvalues.name: steamaudio_pathing_grid_spacing

keyvalues.description: The height (in meters) above the floor at which probes should be placed..
keyvalues.name: steamaudio_pathing_height_above_floor

keyvalues.description: Number of point samples to use around each probe when testing whether one probe can see another. To determine if two probes are mutually visible, rays are traced from each point sample of the first probe, to every other point sample of the second probe. Increasing this value prevents paths from being considered occluded by small objects, at the cost of increased bake times.
keyvalues.name: steamaudio_pathing_visibility_samples

keyvalues.description: When testing for mutual visibility between a pair of probes, each probe is treated as a sphere of this radius (in meters), and point samples are generated within this sphere.
keyvalues.name: steamaudio_pathing_visibility_radius

keyvalues.description: When tracing rays to test for mutual visibility between a pair of probes, the fraction of rays that are unoccluded must be greater than this threshold for the pair of probes to be considered mutually visible.
keyvalues.name: steamaudio_pathing_visibility_threshold

keyvalues.description: If the distance (in meters) between two probes is greater than this value, the probes are considered to not have any path between them. Increasing this value allows sound to propagate over greater distances, at the cost of increased bake times and memory usage.
keyvalues.name: steamaudio_pathing_visibility_pathrange

keyvalues.description:
Cleanup: Custom bake is disabled. Baked data will be cleaned up during map compile in Hammer or mapbuilder.
Manual: Custom data needs to be baked manually. Baked data is added or updated during map compile in Hammer but untouched by mapbuilder.
Auto: Custom data is baked automatically during map compile. Baked data is added or updated during map compile in Hammer or mapbuilder.
keyvalues.name: steamaudio_customdata_rebake_option

keyvalues.description:
Automatic, Everywhere: When baking, probes will be generated to cover the entire map.
Automatic, Use Probe Generation Volumes: When baking, probes will only be generated within Probe Generation Volumes that have been explicitly placed in the map.
Manual: When baking, probes will not be generated. Only probes that have been manually placed in the map will be used.
keyvalues.name: steamaudio_customdata_generation_type

keyvalues.description:
Don't generate probes inside Probe Exclusion Volumes that have been placed in the map.
(Only used if Generation Type is set to Automatic, Everywhere.)
keyvalues.name: steamaudio_customdata_filter_volumes

keyvalues.description:
Only generate probes that are near the nav mesh.
(Only used if Generation Type is set to Automatic, Everywhere.)
keyvalues.name: steamaudio_customdata_filter_navmesh

keyvalues.description: The horizontal distance (in meters) between adjacent probes.
keyvalues.name: steamaudio_customdata_grid_spacing

keyvalues.description: The height (in meters) above the floor at which probes should be placed..
keyvalues.name: steamaudio_customdata_height_above_floor

keyvalues.description: Bake custom occlusion data between probe pairs.
keyvalues.name: steamaudio_customdata_bake_occlusion

keyvalues.description: Bake occlusion dimensions data (size and inside outside) per probe.
keyvalues.name: steamaudio_customdata_bake_dimensions

keyvalues.description: Bake custom materials data (top 3 nearby materials) per probe.
keyvalues.name: steamaudio_customdata_bake_materials

keyvalues.description: Simulate reflections when computing baked occlusion.
keyvalues.name: steamaudio_customdata_occlusion_reflection

keyvalues.description: Number of rays to simulate reflections.
keyvalues.name: steamaudio_customdata_occlusion_reflection_rays

keyvalues.description: Number of bounces to simulate reflections.
keyvalues.name: steamaudio_customdata_occlusion_reflection_bounces
